newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia telecom NGTS sees 96 dividend at 1,090 rbls.
newsitem.headline: Russia telecom NGTS sees 96 dividend at 1,090 rbls.

text.p: Russian regional telecoms company Novosibirskaya Gorodskaya Telefonnaya Set (NGTS) said on Monday it planned a 1996 dividend of 1,090 roubles per ordinary share, or 2,725 percent of the nominal value of each share.
An NGTS spokeswoman also said the company planned to pay a dividend of 6,590 roubles (16,475 percent of nominal value) per preferred share for 1996.

Vera Belosludtseva, deputy managing director for economics at the company, said a dividend payment of 174 roubles per ordinary share with a nominal value of 40 roubles was paid in 1995 and a dividend of 1,720 roubles per preferred share also with a nominal value of 40 roubles.
She said NGTS 0#NVTL.RUO also planned to boost authorised capital to 591.4 billion roubles in 1997 from the current level of 80.4 million roubles.
Each share with a nominal value of 40 roubles would be turned into 2,944 shares each with a value of 100 roubles, said Yelena Lisichkina, secretary to the board of directors.
The planned dividend payments and authorised capital increases need to be approved by shareholders at a meeting on May 15.

The main shareholders in NGTS are OAO Svyazinvest (with 50.66 percent of shares), Salomon Brothers (21 percent), CS First Boston (14 percent) and OAO Brokerkreditservis (Novosibirsk) (with four percent).
